verdicts.rationale: Each lists the extension order TypeScript tries for one module kind; the lists differ and mirror the compiler's own tables.
outcome handles a missing grpc-status and delegates to succeeded, which checks the code; they compose rather than repeat.
Each maps imports of a different upstream plugin's layout to virtual modules; the id derivation differs per upstream.
problemInFile reports at the start of a file; itemProblem reports at a Rust item's position.
Cache read with a trace message versus resolution that writes the cache.
subpathsOf keeps every export entry for public-entry checks; subpathTargetsOf keeps only concrete non-wildcard targets for dependency checks.
Each CLI builds its own service layer; msch adds repository files, tracing and an HTTP client.
Tempo points from MIDI bars in microseconds versus from song bars in BPM.
Different upstream layouts resolved by different patterns.
Variable lookup with lazy global evaluation versus assignment into the innermost frame.
parseString uses checkString and then returns the text; they compose.
Different upstream layouts resolved by different patterns.
Output formats of two separate linters; the fumx linter prints the whole line and the Markdown linter only the detail suffix.
FSD layer name of a path versus the parent directory of a path.
Comment readers for two formats with different parsers.
anyValue decodes an OTLP AnyValue and uses kvlist for the key-value case.
checkWorkflow checks the whole workflow and calls checkEvents for its triggers.
Different syntax shapes checked by different rules.
Handling of an escaped character versus the main dispatch step of the glob validator.
Action outputs reject duplicates as actionlint does; reusable workflow outputs do not. The behaviour differs on purpose to match actionlint.
Different steps of TypeScript module resolution.

vite-plus-adopt and msch are separate published packages and msch depends on vite-plus-adopt only through its CLI; isUnder is a one-line prefix test over archive paths and not part of vite-plus-adopt's public API.
Each lists the extension order TypeScript tries for one source extension; the orders and the explicit-flag conditions differ and mirror the compiler's own tables.
Both pick regex sets by entry kind; python adds a tool-versions branch the docker version lacks, and each set is that tool's own.
endsAt compares a sounding's end tick, startsAt its start tick; they are two one-line predicates over different fields.
esmAttempts and jsxAttempts list different extension tables with different explicit conditions, following the compiler.
Both append ignore globs to a pathspec list; workflows also add the not-owned set and the default patterns differ. Each file is that tool's own section module.
opened starts a brace scan and inside continues it; they are two states of one scanner.
bashTargets reads bash variable nodes and pwshVariables reads PowerShell variable nodes; the grammars differ.
finishSteps and finishCall report different missing-key errors for a job; the checks and messages are separate rules.

the Markdown engine reads a node table with line starts and text, the workflow engine reads separate semantic and concrete trees with errors. The binary layouts are different formats that each engine's native addon defines.
versionOf dispatches on the ref kind and symbolicVersion resolves the longest tag for a named ref; one calls the other.
findAncestor is the nullable wrapper over ancestorMatching, which holds the loop.
The two section helpers call parseSection with different case and emptiness options for different workflow sections.
readmeProblem and agentDocProblem apply different placement rules and messages to nested documents.
setIn writes to the innermost frame, assignIn finds the holding frame and rejects unknown names; the semantics differ.
checkAssignment reports assignment statements and checkName reports declared names; they visit different nodes with different exemptions.
lenientUnsigned accepts any scalar that looks like digits, unsigned accepts only an !!int tag; the strictness is the difference.
wism-presets and fu4-presets are separate published packages with no shared dependency, and each is a one-line prefix strip.
fileUrlVolumeRoot parses a drive volume in a file URL and urlRootAt chooses between that and the plain root.
fu4-presets and msch are separate published packages with no shared dependency, and the function is a one-line split and last.
fu4-presets splits mdast into sections for data generation and y8-presets splits by heading level for rules; the section shapes differ and the packages share no dependency.
keywordOf reads the first child's text and wordOf unwraps a single-child string node.
linksOf selects link and image nodes and proseNodes selects text nodes outside code.
mangle and unmangle are inverse conversions of scoped package names.
The Markdown engine and the workflow engine are separate published packages with no shared dependency; the function is a one-line minimatch wrapper in each.
lookupIn reads a binding with lazy top-level evaluation and assignIn writes it with scope rules.
The gRPC and HTTP test servers build different server layers and handlers and only share the origin step.
skillMd and agentsMd configure different rule sets and file globs for different documents.
The superfluous-actions step reports pattern recommendations and the forbidden-uses step reports denied actions, with different severities.
defaulted checks only that a node is a scalar and non-null, checkString also rejects empty strings and reports a different message.
getDeclarationFileExtension tries the supported suffixes then falls back to getArbitraryDeclarationExtension; they port two TypeScript compiler functions.
packageJsonScopeOf finds the package scope and impliedFormatOf derives a module format from extensions and that scope; both port TypeScript compiler functions.
The impostor-commit check needs a ref slug and a commit ref and the vulnerable-actions check needs a slug only; they query different things.
isSliced tests the sliced layers and isLayer tests the ordered layers.
repoOf takes the first path segment and baseName takes the last.
aliasSite follows a type alias and annotationSite follows an expression's annotation and then calls aliasSite.
memoizeByKey holds results in a WeakMap keyed by object and memoize in a Map keyed by string; they are in separate packages and the key type and lifetime differ.
handWrittenNameProblems orchestrates three checks and subsetListProblem is one of them.
checkLoopVariable reports a loop variable and checkName handles every other declared name.
tokenAt builds a token from a scan span and eof builds the end token with an empty value.
stillSounding compares an end to a start and startsAt compares a start to a tick.
checkAssignment and checkLoopVariable visit different node kinds.
stillSounding compares an end to a start and endsAt compares an end to a tick.
objectValuesOf reads literal property types and propertyNamesOf reads property names.
sequencesOf dispatches on node type and splitAtThen is its branch for if and elif.
spanOf returns start and end points and commentOf returns the raw text, start and offset.
slopRule adds a cutoff and builds its question inline and claimRule builds it with questionOf; the two rule families have different fields.
voiceOf resolves a voice line and sourceKindOf matches the track source kinds.
parseEnv reads a variable map and parseEnvironment reads name, url and deployment with a required name.
loadAsFile resolves a file and attaches package info and packageInfoOfFile finds that info; both port TypeScript compiler functions.
sectionsOf builds sections up to the next heading of the same level and headingsOf lists the headings.
readAnalysis decodes a cache entry and writeAnalysis encodes one; they are inverses with different path conversions.
endOfInput and unexpected both end lexing with an eof token but build different error messages and positions.
msch and wism-presets are separate published packages with no shared dependency; relativeTo also normalizes separators.
repoOf takes the first path segment and baseName takes the last.
statementOf tries importOf and then declarationOf; it composes them.
describe renders workflow types and typeName renders song types; the type models differ and the packages are separate.
displayEnv prints a workflow env value and valueText quotes a string value for a message.
effectiveWordOf resolves the effective command word and declaredName reads a declared variable name.
obfuscation reports opaque with inputs and the superfluous-actions step matches known patterns; the findings differ.
symbolOfDeclaration reads a symbol at a name node and fromPosition asks the session checker by file position and throws if it is missing.
checkAssignment and checkCommandWrites visit different node kinds.
literalOf extracts a literal word and keywordOf reads the first child's text.
literalOf extracts a literal word and declaredName reads a variable name.
resolveNonRelative and resolveRelative port the two resolution paths of the TypeScript compiler.
eventsOf collects the named events and namedBody decodes one of them.
cellsOf converts controls to cells and controlLinesOf groups controls per controller and calls cellsOf.
heldName finds the name of the holder and nameNodeOf chooses a name node per node kind and calls heldName.
parentOf returns the directory part of a path and baseName returns its last segment.
fromBound picks a source-file, export or position strategy and fromPosition is one strategy.
pwshName reads a PowerShell command name and literalOf extracts a literal bash word.
importedOf collects shared declarations per module and importedDeclarationsOf lists the imported declarations.
declaredName reads a name from a declaration child and targetOf reads the name and subscript flag of an assignment.
subHeadingsOf filters headings by level and sectionsOf groups blocks under headings.
bindFunctionVariable binds a function variable at file scope and inContainer binds with caller-given flags; both port TypeScript binder code.
effectiveWordOf resolves the effective command word and assignedName reads an assigned variable name.
versionOf finds the version for a ref and check turns the result into findings.
checkJobPost checks environment and outputs and checkSections checks concurrency, env, defaults and if.
versionOf finds a version for a ref and check tests a commit for impostor status.
defaultAttempts lists the TypeScript extensions and jsonAttempts lists the JSON ones.
hasCallOrConstructSignatures tests for any signature and calleeTakesExactly requires signatures with an exact parameter count.
esmAttempts and jsonAttempts list different extension tables.
The two problemsIn functions scan different sources with different patterns and messages.
decodeAction and reusableOf share the yaml error prefix and decode different documents.
checkCommandWrites and checkName visit different node kinds.
restOf computes a rest's length and soundingOf also builds the items.
fu4-presets collects shell syntax ancestors in a loop and oxlint-plugin-decision unfolds ESTree ancestors; the node types and packages differ.
parentOf returns the directory part of a path and below strips a prefix.
effectiveWordOf resolves the effective command word and literalOf extracts a literal word.
stateTextOf returns the state of the first matching request and sentFor lists the matching questions.
unsoundTrueValues collects values and walk tracks dominating conditions; the recursions differ.
The parser's literalOf reads a token and the checker's literalOf reads an expression; the inputs differ.
explainerOf builds an Explainer from explainPassOf.
declaredName reads a name from a declaration child and assignedName reads an assignment's name with the underscore filter.
execAction builds the action entry and parseWith reads its with section.
hasBackslash checks a local destination for a backslash and isDocsLink checks an external link against a docs pattern.
subHeadingsOf filters the headings that headingsOf returns.
hasSubstitution looks for a substitution in a word and isInQuotedBackticks checks the enclosing backticks.
decodeBoolean decodes a boolean and defaulted checks scalar shape and null.
stringsOption reads a list with a fallback and stringOption reads one optional string.
parsePrimary peeks a token and parseToken parses it.
